definitions.def: an artist who creates pictures using paint
a work of art that is the best one an artist has made
the state of being known or accepted publicly for an achievement
given as an honor, without the usual requirements
to study or examine something in order to learn more about it

grammar_choice.en_template: Jacob Lawrence was an American painter {{1:known/knowing}} for vivid scenes of African-American history and daily {{2:life/lives}}.
grammar_choice.ko_full: Jacob Lawrence는 아프리카계 미국인의 역사와 일상의 생생한 장면으로 알려진 미국 화가였다.
explain: painter가 '알려지는' 대상 → 수동 의미의 과거분사 known (be known for).
daily life는 불가산 단수 표현 → life.

grammar_choice.en_template: {{1:Born/Bearing}} in Atlantic City in 1917, he {{2:moved/was moved}} to Harlem at 13 and studied art at Utopia Children's Center.
grammar_choice.ko_full: 1917년 Atlantic City에서 태어나, 그는 13세에 Harlem으로 이주했고 Utopia Children's Center에서 미술을 공부했다.

grammar_choice.en_template: He {{1:used/was used}} bright colors and {{2:simplified/simplifying}} shapes in his paintings.
grammar_choice.ko_full: 그는 그림에 밝은 색채와 단순화된 형태를 사용했다.

grammar_choice.en_template: The Migration Series, widely {{1:regarded/regarding}} as Jacob Lawrence's masterpiece, {{2:brought/bringing}} him national recognition.
grammar_choice.ko_full: Jacob Lawrence의 걸작으로 널리 여겨지는 The Migration Series는 그에게 전국적인 명성을 가져다주었다.
explain: The Migration Series가 '여겨지는' 대상 → 수동 과거분사 regarded.

grammar_choice.en_template: During World War II, he served in the U.S. Coast Guard and produced many paintings, but most of {{1:them/it}} {{2:were/was}} lost.
grammar_choice.ko_full: 2차 세계대전 동안 그는 미국 해안경비대에서 복무했고 많은 그림을 그렸지만, 그중 대부분은 분실되었다.
explain: 복수 명사 paintings를 받는 대명사 → them.
most of them(복수)이 주어 → 복수 동사 were.

grammar_choice.en_template: Later, he {{1:taught/teached}} at the University of Washington {{2:for/during}} 16 years.
grammar_choice.ko_full: 이후 그는 Washington 대학교에서 16년 동안 가르쳤다.

grammar_choice.en_template: Throughout his lifetime, he received honorary degrees from several {{1:universities/university}}, {{2:including/included}} Harvard.
grammar_choice.ko_full: 평생에 걸쳐 그는 Harvard를 포함한 여러 대학교로부터 명예 학위를 받았다.
explain: 수량 형용사 several 뒤에는 복수 명사 → universities.
'~을 포함하여'를 뜻하는 전치사처럼 쓰이는 분사 → including.

grammar_choice.en_template: Until a few weeks before his death, he continued {{1:to explore/explored}} the {{2:lives/life}} of African-Americans through his painting.
grammar_choice.ko_full: 사망하기 몇 주 전까지 그는 그림을 통해 아프리카계 미국인의 삶을 계속 탐구했다.
explain: continue + to V (또는 V-ing) → to explore.

jumble.answer: Jacob Lawrence was an American painter known for vivid scenes of African-American history and daily life.
Born in Atlantic City in 1917, he moved to Harlem at 13 and studied art at Utopia Children's Center.
He used bright colors and simplified shapes in his paintings.
The Migration Series, widely regarded as Jacob Lawrence's masterpiece, brought him national recognition.
During World War II, he served in the U.S. Coast Guard and produced many paintings, but most of them were lost.
Later, he taught at the University of Washington for 16 years.
Throughout his lifetime, he received honorary degrees from several universities, including Harvard.
Until a few weeks before his death, he continued to explore the lives of African-Americans through his painting.
